searchText: <@654267572107083777> do you know by any chance if Nimbus cancels ongoing msg transmissions when it receives an IDONTWANT for the same MSG_ID? If so, is this also applied to the ongoing replies of incoming IWANT messages for the same ID?

excerpts.author: cortze
excerpts.content:
<@654267572107083777> do you know by any chance if Nimbus cancels ongoing msg transmissions when it receives an IDONTWANT for the same MSG_ID? 
If so, is this also applied to the ongoing replies of incoming IWANT messages for the same ID?
